import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2020_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts'] if isinstance(data,dict) and 'texts' in data else data
pat=re.compile(r'long[- ]term debt|debt', re.I)
for i,el in enumerate(texts):
    txt=el.get('text','') if isinstance(el,dict) else ''
    if pat.search(txt):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',el.get('page_no'),'LABEL',el.get('label'))
        print(txt[:1000].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
